units.label: My Lai
units.title: My Lai Massacre (1968)
units.question: How could a military unit move from frustration and command failure to mass killing, and what does individual refusal show about inevitability?
units.cognitiveJob: Establish what this case is, what it is doing in Ares, and which of its units to enter. The case metadata and its source-trace boundary live here so every child screen inherits a stated provenance position.

sources.note: Metadata, classification, estimate and uncertainty from cases.json.
Guided question, orientation, finding and limitation authored in #45.

caveats: Every unit of this case inherits an unresolved source-trace state. No child screen may present the estimate, the classification or the retained quotation as verified.

units.label: Orientation
units.title: What happened, and why this case is here
units.question: What happened at Sơn Mỹ on 16 March 1968, and why does Ares include this case?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: place the event and state why it earns a place in the comparison. No extended atrocity detail is required to complete it.

sources.note: Place, period and classification shown as the screen's locator.

caveats: This orientation summarises a contested record. Treat the figures and attributions in it as untraced until the source review reaches this case.

units.label: Core narrative
units.title: The morning at Sơn Mỹ
units.question: How did the morning actually unfold for the unit and for the hamlet?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: read the canonical opening narrative as a continuous account. It scrolls, and it should: breaking a single narrative across screens would destroy the continuity that makes it intelligible.

sources.note: Section A of the canonical case Markdown, rendered whole.

caveats: This is the concise factual account the analysis needs. Extended atrocity detail is not on this screen and is never required to continue.

units.cognitiveJob: One job: hold a bounded evidence set in view before any interpretation is asked for.

units.label: Analytical finding
units.title: What the case can support
units.question: What can this case support analytically, and what can it not?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: state the finding together with the limitation that bounds it. These are not two screens — separating them would let the claim travel without its qualification.
caveats: The finding is bounded by an unresolved source-trace state, and the limitation on this screen is part of the claim rather than a footnote to it.

units.label: Scholarly depth
units.title: The complete My Lai record
units.question: What does the complete case record contain beyond the essential unit?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: inspect the full record. Historical context, atrocity pattern, drivers, the complete chronology and the aftermath are one scholarly document, and paginating a reader through a record they came to consult would make it harder to use, not easier.

caveats: Reaching this screen is always an explicit choice, and leaving it costs nothing: the analytical finding stands complete without it.
units.note: Ambiguity recorded rather than resolved: B, D, E, C and F are five canonical sections and each could become a child screen. #51 keeps them as one depth surface because the essential path already answers the case's analytical question. Whether depth itself needs children is a #47 question that real-reader evidence should settle.
